notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check that a successful time-regulated timestamped SendDirectedInteraction produces the standard HLAreportServiceInvocation MOM interaction at the accepted-send boundary and later reaches the active directed recipient at its logical timestamp. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM data elements, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, ordinary FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration. It verifies callback-model timing, typed directed-send arguments, the dynamic standard message-retraction return argument, logical-time and order metadata, target identity, reliable transportation, and callback-before-grant ordering. Provider-private headers, registries, file sinks, names, and diagnostics are outside this contract.
